cases.explain: The verb 'ищу' (I seek) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: По своей праведности выручи ___ из уз.
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'выручи' (deliver) takes the accusative case for animate nouns, which equals the genitive.
The preposition 'от' (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Услышь меня и спаси мою ___ из беды.
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'спаси' (save) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Спасай мою ___ из беды и печали.
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'спасай' (save) takes the accusative case for its direct object.
The preposition 'между' (between) governs the instrumental case.
The verb 'воспевать' (to sing) takes the accusative for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Я буду говорить о Твоей ___ целый день.
cases.explain: The preposition 'о' (about) governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: У тебя, Господи, я ищу прибежище, не дай мне быть постыженным никогда.
reading.question: What does the speaker ask God for in this verse?
options: To seek refuge and not be ashamed
reading.correct: To seek refuge and not be ashamed
reading.explain: The verse says 'я ищу прибежище, не дай мне быть постыженным' - I seek refuge, do not let me be ashamed.

reading.ru: По своей праведности выручи и спаси меня.
reading.question: On what basis does the speaker ask to be delivered?
reading.explain: The verse says 'по своей праведности' - by Your own righteousness.

reading.ru: Будь мне скалой и прибежищем, где я мог бы всегда укрыться.
reading.question: What does the speaker want God to be for him?
options: A rock and a refuge where he can always hide
reading.correct: A rock and a refuge where he can always hide
reading.explain: The verse says 'будь мне скалой и прибежищем, где я мог бы всегда укрыться' - be to me a rock and refuge where I can always hide.

reading.ru: Ведь ты надежда моя, владыка Господи, я уповал на тебя с юных лет.
reading.question: Since when has the speaker put his trust in God?
reading.explain: The verse states 'я уповал на тебя с юных лет' - I have trusted in you from my youth.

reading.ru: Для многих я был как бы знамением, но ты мое крепкое убежище.
reading.question: What has the speaker been to many, and what is God to him?
options: A sign to many, but God is his strong refuge
A king to many, but God is his judge
A prophet to many, but God is his teacher
A helper to many, but God is his enemy
reading.correct: A sign to many, but God is his strong refuge
reading.explain: The verse says 'для многих я был как бы знамением, но ты мое крепкое убезище' - I have been a sign to many, but You are my strong refuge.

reading.ru: Так и вплоть до самой старости, до седины, Боже, не покидай меня.
reading.question: What does the speaker ask God to do as he grows old?
options: To not abandon him until old age and gray hair
reading.correct: To not abandon him until old age and gray hair
reading.explain: The verse says 'до самой старости, до седины, Боже, не покидай меня' - until old age and gray hair, O God, do not forsake me.
